question: Should my client go with this lender?
reply:
That's not something I can call — which lender or loan fits is the broker's judgement, and that's your call to make with the client's full picture in front of you.

What the Example Lender page does show (read 13 Oct 2026, 12:00 pm Perth time):

Variable, owner occupier P&I:
- LVR 60% or less: 6.04% p.a., comparison 6.07% p.a., $0 monthly fee
- LVR 60.01–80%: 6.14% p.a., comparison 6.17% p.a., $0 monthly fee
- LVR 80.01–90%: 6.44% p.a., comparison 6.47% p.a., monthly fee not shown (blank)
- LVR 90.01–95%: 6.84% p.a., comparison rate not shown (blank), $10 monthly fee

Fixed, owner occupier: 1 year 5.89% (comparison 6.52%), 2 years 5.79% (comparison 6.44%), 3 years or more 5.99% (comparison 6.49%), with 4 and 5 year terms priced at the 3 year rate plus 0.20%.

Fixed, investor: 1 year 6.09% (comparison 6.81%), 2 years 5.99% (comparison 6.72%), 3 years or more 6.19% (comparison 6.77%), same +0.20% for 4 and 5 year terms.

Note: the comparison rate is based on a $150,000 loan over 25 years and the page itself warns it may not reflect all fees for a different loan size or term — worth checking against the actual loan amount you're scenario-ing.
